description: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of three different models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni—on the MMAR benchmark when using audio input, noise input, and random choice as baselines. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 60 with a dashed horizontal line at 30%, while the horizontal axis lists the three models. For each model, three bars are displayed: blue for audio input, purple for noise input, and a light gray dashed line representing random choice. Qwen2-Audio-Instruct achieves an audio accuracy of approximately 30%, while noise input yields around 23%. Audio-Reasoner shows an audio accuracy of about 37% and noise input around 31%. Qwen-2.5-Omni demonstrates the highest performance, with audio input reaching approximately 57% and noise input at about 36%. The random choice baseline is consistently at 30% across all models, serving as a reference point. The chart highlights that audio input generally leads to higher accuracy than noise input, with Qwen-2.5-Omni showing the most significant improvement over the noise baseline.
